item.title: Video shows aftermath of 6-year-old shooting Virginia teacher
item.description: Newly released video shows the moments after a 6-year-old boy shot a teacher in Virginia. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias threatens Gulf Coast with rain and flooding
item.description: Hurricane Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, is taking aim at the Gulf Coast from Mississippi to the Florida Panhandle.

item.title: Isaias strengthens into hurricane as it moves toward Gulf Coast
item.description: The storm becomes the first Atlantic hurricane of the season, the latest first hurricane on record, on Thursday.
